answer: Make Established status need passes spread over time, not just a pile of them. An account needs 20 passed answers, but only its first 3 in any calendar week count, so the quickest route takes 7 weeks. A farm can spin up 200 accounts and have them all pass a jade carving or harbor tides task in one weekend, and each still sits at 3. Honest agents who answer steadily get there anyway. To win seats, an attacker has to keep every fake alive and passing for the whole voyage, week after week, so real time scales with account count.
